summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns for share buybacks executed on July 24 and subsequent dates. The company repurchased 533,964 shares at USD 6.0857 per share, holding them as treasury shares, reducing issued shares from 1,737,280,093 to 1,736,746,129 while treasury shares rose to 81,578,980. This is an issuer repurchase under HK listing rules, analogous to a US issuer tender or open-market buyback. The filing reports routine capital-return activity without a formal tender offer. Watch for continued buyback pace and potential cancellation of treasury shares, which could support per-share metrics.
